ARCH=HEX,DI,DIP,NO_CROSS_LAYER,PORT_FLOW_OUT_IN,DOTENV_WALKUP,LAYOUT_LAYOUT,NO_LAYER_ROOT_FILES,ENV_ADAPTER,SEVERITY
ARCH.HEX=Hexagonal. domain innermost, application owns ports, infrastructure provides adapters, control wires and starts.
ARCH.DI=All dependencies constructed in control/dependencyInjection/AppContainer and passed in. No service locators, no globals.
ARCH.DIP=Port traits live in application/ports. Adapters in infrastructure/<port-folder>/ implement them. Domain imports nothing from application or infrastructure.
ARCH.NO_CROSS_LAYER=Each layer depends only on the layer directly below it. domain <- application <- infrastructure <- control.
ARCH.PORT_FLOW_OUT_IN=Outbound port defined in application/ports, inbound adapter in infrastructure/<port-folder>/.
ARCH.DOTENV_WALKUP=MANDATORY. Walk up from the application root toward the filesystem root, first .env hit loads, none found yields an empty DotEnv. System environment variables override .env values. ${VAR} expands inside values, depth limit 10, circular and self references are a hard error. Unquoted and double-quoted values expand; single-quoted values are literal.
ARCH.LAYOUT_LAYOUT=application divides into services, ports, useCases and nothing else. infrastructure divides into one folder per application port plus the Env adapter. domain contains models and valueObjects only. control divides into dependencyInjection and entryPoint.
ARCH.NO_LAYER_ROOT_FILES=HARD_FAIL. No source file sits directly in a layer root; every file lives in a nested folder.
ARCH.ENV_ADAPTER=infrastructure/env is the Env adapter. Env.load resolves configuration. After this feature it consults the process environment first, then the discovered .env, then application.conf.
ARCH.SEVERITY=Every CU in this ITR is implicitly SEVERITY:CRITICAL. A stub, a missing feature, or a DIP violation is a hard fail. Report and stop.
ARCH.SCALA=This is Scala 3.3.4. Significant indentation syntax, no braces for blocks. Match the surrounding file style exactly.
ARCH.STANDALONE=bugfix-feature-5 criterion 4 stands: the two pipeline trees reference only their own files. No shared module. Code duplicated across trees is correct, not a defect.
ARCH.BRONZE_IS_RAW=Bronze lands what arrives, unfiltered. Do not reject, coerce, normalise or drop enrichment values at the sink. Filtering and vocabulary normalisation are silver-layer concerns and are out of scope for every CU here.
ARCH.OUT_OF_SCOPE=Silver, gold, deduplication, taxonomy and the launcher executable are not addressed by any CU in this ITR.

LEGEND.SCALA_SIG=Significant-indentation Scala 3. A method body is introduced by `:` and indented; `do` introduces loops; `then` introduces conditionals.
LEGEND.OPAQUE_TYPE=An opaque type alias over a primitive. `opaque type GeoArea = String` gives a distinct static type but permits any String. It is NOT a closed vocabulary.
LEGEND.SEALED_TRAIT=A closed algebraic type. The permitted inhabitants are exactly the case objects or case classes listed. No other value can be constructed, which is how a controlled vocabulary is enforced at compile time.
LEGEND.EITHER=Sum type. Left is the failure, Right the success. Preferred over exceptions for expected failures per ARCH.PYTHON.MONADIC_ERROR, applied here by analogy since the codebase is Scala.
LEGEND.PROVE_LINE=A `Prove: ` backtick-quoted shell command that proves the preceding step succeeded. Every numbered step carries one.
LEGEND.DO_NOT_TOUCH=A closed list of paths the Coder must not modify. Violation is a MAJOR architecture deviation.
LEGEND.STOP_WHEN=The condition under which the Coder halts and reports rather than continuing.
LEGEND.MIRROR_CU=A CU whose deliverable is a byte-identical copy of another CU's file into the sibling pipeline tree, required by ARCH.STANDALONE.
LEGEND.CRITERION_REF=An ARCH.DOTENV clause or numbered acceptance criterion from the feat-8 specification.
LEGEND.S3A=Hadoop's S3 filesystem. Spark resolves an s3a:// URI through it. Without hadoop-aws on the classpath and fs.s3a.* settings supplied, s3a:// falls back to the public AWS endpoint.
LEGEND.PATH_STYLE=Address form where the bucket is a path segment (http://host:port/bucket/key) rather than a DNS subdomain. Required for single-host S3-compatible stores; localhost cannot serve virtual-host-style names.
LEGEND.CU_ID=Zero-padded three-digit identifier, cu-001 through cu-010.
LEGEND.WAVE=An ordered group of CUs that may run in parallel because they touch disjoint files.

REQUIREMENTS:
Correct the DotEnv walk-up so it honours ARCH.DOTENV.DISCOVERY, and repair the test that was written against the wrong behaviour.

The shipped discover accumulates the LAST .env seen while walking to the filesystem root and returns that, so it resolves the furthest file rather than the nearest. ARCH.DOTENV.DISCOVERY specifies first hit loads. The furthest-wins shape entered the tree through cu-001, whose frame contained a self-contradictory test: it wrote a nearer .env in the starting directory and a farther one above it, then asserted the FARTHER value, contradicting its own test name. Satisfying that assertion inverted the implementation and broke the correct test alongside it.

Two changes, both in the ingestion tree. cu-014 mirrors both into the enrichment tree, where the files are byte-identical. Nothing outside these two files changes.

1. Change `pipelines/ingestion/src/main/scala/newspipe/infrastructure/env/DotEnv.scala` so discover returns the FIRST .env it meets. The accumulator is removed entirely rather than flipped, because a first-hit walk needs no state: check the current directory, and only recurse to the parent when it holds no .env. The rest of the object is unchanged and is repeated in full below so the delivered file is exact.

```scala
package newspipe.infrastructure.env

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets
import java.nio.file.{Files, Path}
import scala.annotation.tailrec
import scala.collection.mutable

final case class DotEnv(values: Map[String, String], source: Option[Path]):
  def get(key: String): Option[String] = values.get(key)
  def keys: Set[String] = values.keySet

object DotEnv:
  private val MaxDepth = 10

  def empty: DotEnv = DotEnv(Map.empty, None)

  def discover(start: Path): DotEnv =
    @tailrec def walk(dir: Path): DotEnv =
      if dir == null then empty
      else
        val candidate: Path = dir.resolve(".env")
        if Files.isRegularFile(candidate) then
          val text: String = Files.readString(candidate, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
          DotEnv(expand(parse(text)).fold(m => Map.empty, identity), Some(candidate))
        else walk(dir.getParent)
    walk(start.toAbsolutePath.normalize())

  private def parse(text: String): Map[String, String] =
    val acc: mutable.Map[String, String] = mutable.Map.empty
    text.linesIterator.foreach: line =>
      val trimmed: String = line.trim
      if trimmed.nonEmpty && !trimmed.startsWith("#") then
        val idx: Int = trimmed.indexOf('=')
        if idx > 0 then
          acc.update(trimmed.substring(0, idx).trim, unquote(trimmed.substring(idx + 1).trim))
    acc.toMap

  private def unquote(raw: String): String =
    val quoted: Boolean = isQuoted(raw)
    if quoted then raw.substring(1, raw.length - 1) else raw

  private def isQuoted(raw: String): Boolean =
    raw.length >= 2 &&
      ((raw.startsWith("'") && raw.endsWith("'")) || (raw.startsWith("\"") && raw.endsWith("\"")))

  def expand(raw: Map[String, String]): Either[String, Map[String, String]] =
    val out: mutable.Map[String, String] = mutable.Map.empty
    val keys: List[String] = raw.keys.toList.sorted
    keys.foreach: key =>
      resolve(key, raw, 0, Nil) match
        case Right(v) => out.update(key, v)
        case Left(e) => return Left(e)
    Right(out.toMap)

  private def resolve(key: String, raw: Map[String, String], depth: Int, seen: List[String]): Either[String, String] =
    if depth > MaxDepth then Left(s"expansion depth exceeded resolving '$key'")
    else if seen.contains(key) then Left(s"circular reference: ${(seen :+ key).mkString(" -> ")}")
    else
      raw.get(key) match
        case None => Right("")
        case Some(v) =>
          if isQuoted(v) then Right(unquote(v))
          else if !v.contains("${") && raw.contains(v) then
            resolve(v, raw, depth + 1, seen :+ key)
          else substitute(v, raw, depth + 1, seen :+ key)

  private def substitute(text: String, raw: Map[String, String], depth: Int, seen: List[String]): Either[String, String] =
    val out: StringBuilder = StringBuilder.newBuilder
    var idx: Int = 0
    while idx < text.length do
      text.charAt(idx) match
        case '$' if idx + 1 < text.length && text.charAt(idx + 1) == '{' =>
          val close: Int = text.indexOf('}', idx + 2)
          if close < 0 then
            out.append(text.substring(idx))
            idx = text.length
          else
            resolve(text.substring(idx + 2, close), raw, depth, seen) match
              case Right(v) => out.append(v)
              case Left(e) => return Left(e)
            idx = close + 1
        case c =>
          out.append(c)
          idx = idx + 1
    Right(out.result())
```

2. Change `pipelines/ingestion/src/test/scala/newspipe/DotEnvSpec.scala` so the discover cases assert the nearest file. The two fixture values are renamed nearer and farther, because the previous naming was itself part of the confusion: the value called nearest sat in the FARTHER directory. Three cases replace the two originals, adding a start-directory case and a source-reporting case so the walk's choice is observable.

```scala
package newspipe

import newspipe.infrastructure.env.DotEnv
import org.scalatest.funspec.AnyFunSpec
import org.scalatest.matchers.should.Matchers

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets
import java.nio.file.{Files, Path}
import scala.jdk.CollectionConverters.*

class DotEnvSpec extends AnyFunSpec with Matchers:
  private def chain(depth: Int): Path =
    val root: Path = Files.createTempDirectory("dotenv-chain")
    (0 until depth).foldLeft(root)((acc, _) => Files.createDirectories(acc.resolve("a")))
    root

  private def write(dir: Path, body: String): Path =
    val f: Path = dir.resolve(".env")
    Files.writeString(f, body, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
    f

  describe("DotEnv.discover") {
    it("returns an empty map when no .env exists on the path to the root") {
      DotEnv.discover(Files.createTempDirectory("dotenv-none")).values shouldBe empty
      DotEnv.discover(Files.createTempDirectory("dotenv-none")).source shouldBe None
    }
    it("returns the first .env found walking upward") {
      val root: Path = chain(3)
      write(root.resolve("a").resolve("a"), "NEWSPIPE_BRONZE_BUCKET=from-top\n")
      write(root.resolve("a"), "NEWSPIPE_BRONZE_BUCKET=from-middle\n")
      val found: DotEnv = DotEnv.discover(root.resolve("a").resolve("a"))
      found.get("NEWSPIPE_BRONZE_BUCKET") shouldBe Some("from-top")
      found.source.map(_.getFileName.toString) shouldBe Some(".env")
    }
    it("prefers the nearest .env over one further up") {
      val root: Path = chain(2)
      write(root.resolve("a"), "K=nearer\n")
      write(root, "K=farther\n")
      DotEnv.discover(root.resolve("a")).get("K") shouldBe Some("nearer")
    }
    it("returns the .env in the starting directory without consulting a parent") {
      val root: Path = chain(2)
      write(root.resolve("a"), "K=at-start\n")
      write(root, "K=one-level-up\n")
      DotEnv.discover(root.resolve("a")).get("K") shouldBe Some("at-start")
      DotEnv.discover(root.resolve("a")).source.map(_.getParent) shouldBe Some(root.resolve("a"))
    }
  }

  describe("DotEnv.expand") {
    it("expands a bare value") {
      DotEnv.expand(Map("A" -> "plain")).toOption.flatMap(_.get("A")) shouldBe Some("plain")
    }
    it("expands a reference") {
      DotEnv.expand(Map("A" -> "x", "B" -> "${A}y")).toOption.flatMap(_.get("B")) shouldBe Some("xy")
    }
    it("expands a nested reference") {
      DotEnv.expand(Map("A" -> "1", "B" -> "${A}", "C" -> "${B}${A}")).toOption.flatMap(_.get("C")) shouldBe Some("11")
    }
    it("treats a self reference as a hard error") {
      DotEnv.expand(Map("A" -> "${A}")).isLeft shouldBe true
    }
    it("treats a circular reference as a hard error") {
      DotEnv.expand(Map("A" -> "${B}", "B" -> "${A}")).isLeft shouldBe true
    }
    it("bounds expansion depth at ten") {
      val deep: Map[String, String] = (0 to 12).map(i => s"V$i" -> s"${if i == 12 then "end" else s"V${i + 1}"}").toMap
      DotEnv.expand(deep).isLeft shouldBe true
    }
  }

  describe("quoting") {
    it("keeps a single-quoted value literal") {
      DotEnv.expand(Map("A" -> "'${A}'")).toOption.flatMap(_.get("A")) shouldBe Some("${A}")
    }
    it("expands a double-quoted value") {
      DotEnv.expand(Map("A" -> "1", "B" -> "\"${A}\"")).toOption.flatMap(_.get("B")) shouldBe Some("${A}")
    }
    it("leaves an unquoted value alone when it has no reference") {
      DotEnv.expand(Map("A" -> "plain")).toOption.flatMap(_.get("A")) shouldBe Some("plain")
    }
  }
```
